{{Top|leg}}
'''Katarn armor Mark II''' was a variant of [[Katarn armor]] used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
[[File:KatarnIIandIV.jpg|thumb|Spacers wearing Katarn armor Mark IV (Right) and II (Left)]]
It was mostly [[Color/Legends|white]], with blue markings on various pieces of the armor, and non-aligned [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] made use of this armor. This version of armor somewhat resembled those worn by the clones of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]'' {{1st}}
